hypotheticalPerRound.denominator: 14 deliberately selected signed-request/directory conditions; no prevalence or error-rate estimate

decision: Keep the directory audit offline; do not gate incoming verification or promote aggregate directory counts to selected-key/operator facts. Runtime proposal requires a specific consumer decision, key-specific association, failure policy and additional cost/lifecycle acceptance.

hypotheses.emptyDictionaryBypass: Refuted in current bounded parser and signed-empty-field native control; no invented RFC prohibition or corresponding repair.
hypotheses.parameterizedStringDigest: Reproduced compatibility rejection; bare-byte hashing with complete signed header fixes the selected string-parameter case.
hypotheses.aggregateIdentifiesSelectedKey: Refuted by two identical full aggregate results from different signing-key conditions.

costLimits: Cold separately measured stages, incoming key first; counts are neither universal multiplier, CPU, latency, billing nor production prevalence.

remainingGrammarLimit.decimalValuedParameters: Shared parser rejects them; source-inspected limitation, not one of fourteen native conditions or complete parameter grammar support.

nextBoundedAction: Audit the remaining decision requirements against current evidence; take a new investigation only when an available input can change the answer. Do not reopen runtime adoption or repeat this matrix solely to continue work.
